profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer.
profile.summary:
“The first principle is that you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.”  --Richard Feynman

Software Engineer with a tendency to end up in Leadership roles.  I've worked in both systems and application development.  My primary aim is to provide true value with software as quickly as possible:  I am a fan of actual agile development, but appreciate the value of a detailed spec.



Specialties: Software Development
Open Source Software
Linux System development. 
Application Development
Distributed computing
System integration
High Performance Computation Systems:  Beowulf clustering

positions.title: Core Developer, Keystone
positions.description: Code reviews. Keeper of the Gate.  Hand out the -1s like candy on Halloween.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: This is the Open Source Project supported by Red Hat that currently occupies the majority of my waking hours.  Implementing the WebUI as A Javascript Application using JSON/AJAX to talk to the web server.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Integrating various data center management technologies.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer on the Virtual Center team.  We build software for server consoldation in the data center.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Took over as manager for my group.  9 Engineers (including me), doing operating system level clustering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Systems software developer responsible for maintain Scyld Beowulf High Performance Clustering Software.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed system integration into Visa to identify and prevent fraud on the ECommerce website.  

Developed a Distributed system for monitoring image processing.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Developed an Database driven web application to provide visibility into customer usage inside EVault's datacenters.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: As a contractor, helped develope configuration tools for Sun's network storage.  Java nad WBEM development.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description: Lead team to develop web site for tracking services rendered to seniors and persons with long term disabilities for the County of San Francisco Department of Aging and Adult Services
